paragraphs: NorthStar Utilities Solutions sells customer information and billing software for utilities, together with a web-based customer portal and mobile workforce management software. The NorthStar Cloud is a hosted, managed cloud solution for the complete NorthStar CIS suite. SilverBlaze is a web portal designed specifically for utilities.

The customer information system is designed for small to medium-sized utilities and municipalities. Billing can be customized to cover multiple utilities on one statement, including deregulated or alternate energy sources. The system can be hosted on the utility's own server or on the NorthStar Cloud.

NorthStar Utilities Solutions was founded in 1976 as the original business unit of Harris Computer Systems. The company reports serving over 200 utility providers and municipalities across North America and the Caribbean. Case studies on the site name the City of Shelby, NC, the Town of Bedford, VA, the City of Newark, DE, and the City of Concord, NC.

quote.text: We designed the Northstar customer information system for small to medium-sized utilities and municipalities to put your customers first, enhance your office productivity, and lower your operating costs.
